objective: Ignacio buys the last of the hair-rope in Cadiz and signs Don Fausto's bond, which requires a living specimen and not a word less.
hook: Fausto announces he is sailing with the ship.

objective: At sea, Brites makes Ignacio say out loud what happened off the Restinga eleven years ago, and Pau hears the story for the first time.
hook: the date they will raise the shoal is the anniversary, to the day.

objective: Over the shoal Pau feels the song in his bones, which turns the voyage from an argument about whether she exists into a hunt that cannot be called off: Ignacio puts both boats down.
hook: Brites cuts her own plait for rope and does not say why it frightens her.

objective: The first cast fails; the song takes the boats off their line and Brites goes over the side and is hauled back.
hook: she was in the water eleven seconds and cannot say what she saw.

objective: The second cast holds, and in the bottom of the boat Ignacio sees the eleven-year-old tear across her forearm: the hunt he has run for a decade reverses into a debt, and the captor is the man who owes her.
hook: Fausto turns the glass and starts counting from the moment she leaves the water.

objective: In the tank her voice goes from singing to breath in four turns of the glass; Pau keeps the water changed and Ignacio will not come below.
hook: Pau asks the question nobody aboard has asked: what is the proof for, now that they have her.

objective: Fausto produces the bond and sets the course for the Guadalquivir and a hall in Seville; Brites tells Ignacio the price of obeying it and he gives no order either way.
hook: the bar is raised from the masthead at first light.

objective: At the bar Brites refuses the helm and Fausto takes it under the bond, and Ignacio stops arguing about the proof and puts the ship about: from this point he is no longer trying to be believed.
hook: the Restinga is four days astern and there is not much left of her to carry back.

objective: In the glass calm over the shoal Ignacio cuts the hair-rope himself and pays the eleven-year debt with the only thing that was ever worth anything.
hook: she goes under without a sound, and the shoal is bright and empty and proves nothing.

objective: La Alondra comes into Cadiz with an empty hold and a forfeit bond, nobody believes a word of it, and Ignacio finds that he no longer needs them to.
hook: Pau keeps the cut rope, and the anniversary is a year off.
